claim_scope: v2 (Opus P32 F-2, F-9): packet order stays date-first across lineages and numeric within a name; a version cut under an OLDER date prefix (which the newer-dated packet would shadow) is REFUSED at load time by both gates (require_lineage_versions_monotone_with_dates_v1; THV1_LINEAGE_VERSION_REGRESSES_ACROSS_DATES) instead of reordered; the key-parity test covers repo-relative paths. Earlier: The repository test-hygiene gate orders evidence packets by lineage name and NUMERIC -vN version (tools.test_hygiene_evidence_v1.hygiene_lineage_key_v1), the same key the O-008 packet checker uses, so the newest fully current packet is selected for a changed critical path. Before this change the loader sorted file names lexicographically, so a stale -v9 packet outranked -v27 for any path whose bytes it still matched and the gate failed on its other stale pins while the O-008 checker selected v27 (campaign finding at P31, the class of Opus P29 NEW-25 one level deeper). Research-only; grants no authority.
failure_modes: a stale early packet shadows every newer packet of its lineage
the repository gate and the O-008 checker select different packets for the same path

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges a two-packet lineage or a name list, invokes the gate or the key once, and asserts the exact selection.

reject_is_noop.reason: The gate is a pure report over the repository; a rejected selection changes nothing.

mutations.description: revert the loader to lexicographic file order
diverge the lineage key from the O-008 checker's key
accept a version cut under an older date prefix (Opus P32 F-2)

nonclaims: This packet does not establish production readiness or grant any authority.
